title: OPTIcraft X
body:
# OPTIcraft **1.21.11**

## Mods

- **Lithium** : _is a general-purpose optimization mod that focuses on improving various aspects of game physics, chunk loading, mob AI, and other server-side (or single-player) mechanics without compromising vanilla parity._

  _Unlike visual optimization mods (like Sodium or Iris), Lithium improves the logic and processing speed of the game itself._ 

   **Key Benefits:**

    **Reduced Lag**: _Significantly reduces server-side lag (tick time) and improves the responsiveness of the game_.

    **Compatibility**: _Works seamlessly with most Fabric mods because it only optimizes existing mechanics_ [caffeinemc♥](https://modrinth.com/organization/caffeinemc)

- **Sodium** : _a revolutionary, free, and open-source rendering engine replacement for Minecraft. Its primary goal is to drastically increase framerates (FPS) and reduce micro-stutters, particularly on low-end and mid-range hardware_ [caffeinemc♥](https://modrinth.com/organization/caffeinemc)

- **Entinty Culling** : _This mod significantly boosts performance by skipping the rendering of entities (mobs, chests, item frames) that are not visible to the player. By using a background thread to check visibility, it reduces CPU and GPU load without affecting gameplay. Perfect for areas with many chests or large animal farm_ [♥][https://modrinth.com/user/tr7zw]
